description: This file is a shell script defining test cases for a mock Git-LFS integration with Perforce (p4), primarily testing large file handling, file existence, and deletion scenarios.

methods.name: test_file_is_not_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Checks that a specific file is not stored in Mock LFS storage.

methods.name: test_file_is_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that a file and its associated storage pointers exist in Mock LFS storage.

methods.name: test_file_is_deleted_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Ensures that the file is missing in the working directory but its storage exists in Mock LFS storage.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Counts files within a directory to verify storage state.

search-terms: test file in/out of LFS storage
